concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-gift-cards-stored-value-api-change-status]] — 2020-modified, 2026-09-15-captured Stored Value API gift-card activation/deactivation guide for provider/channel limits, preload amount, token and no-token paths, irreversible deactivation and result-code interpretation.
warnings: Captured provider/channel matrix crosses online activation and activation+load for Givex, SVS, Fiserv/ValueLink and Intersolve; only Givex online/in-person deactivation without amount is checked. Do not generalize endpoint prose/examples to availability.
Deactivation is described as an end state with remaining value unavailable; a separate void link does not state reactivation.
Success is the response result that means status change occurred; sample Success is not evidence of an executed operation.
